title: These are so adorable and hold 2" planters.
text: These are so adorable and hold 2" planters.. Had propagated my jade philodendron and wanted some whimsy on my lit plant shelves. These planters are absolutely precious and easily accommodate a 2" terracotta pot or liner. Without liner, you could fit a bit more soil than a 2" pot might hold, but filling in the entire inside might interfere with the drainage and be difficult to upgrade pot sizes later without harming the root system. Drainage is down two of the four legs into the water trays they stand upon. I just used some kitchen cotton twine as a water wick internally up into my 2" pot.
